findings.title: Shared memory (/dev/shm) is too small
findings.cause: container trainer exits because shared memory (/dev/shm) is full: nothing is mounted at /dev/shm, so it is the container runtime's 64 MiB; its log says: "dd: error writing '/dev/shm/batch': No space left on device"; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container trainer exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container trainer's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
dd: error writing '/dev/shm/batch': No space left on device
65+0 records in
64+0 records out
67108864 bytes (64.0MB) copied, 0.094600 seconds, 676.5MB/s

findings.fix: Mount an emptyDir with medium: Memory at /dev/shm, with a sizeLimit for what the app needs (it counts toward the container's memory limit), or have the app use less shared memory (fewer DataLoader workers, for one).
